title: ShareCore
description: Shared Hardcore mechanics/hearts for Paper servers — damage, hunger, XP, potions, drowning, and death are synced between players.
body:
ShareCore turns your server into a **shared hardcore experience**.

If one player takes damage, starves, drowns, gains XP, or dies — the entire group is affected.  
Perfect for challenge runs, co-op survival, and hardcore duo/trio playthroughs.

## ✨ Features
- Shared health & healing
- Shared hunger & saturation
- Shared drowning (air + damage)
- Shared XP & levels
- Shared potion effects
- Shared death (one dies → all die)
- Creative & Spectator players excluded (configurable)
- Clean ActionBar + Chat UI (toggleable)
- Fully configurable via `config.yml`

## ❌ Not Included
- Shared fire is **disabled by default** and not part of the current release

## ⚙️ Commands
- /sharecore on
- /sharecore off
- /sharecore toggle
- /sharecore status
- /sharecore reload

Permission: `sharecore.admin` (default: OP)

## 🛠 Configuration
All features can be enabled/disabled in `config.yml`.

- Toggle individual shared mechanics
- Control UI visibility
- Hardcore-only mode supported

## 📌 Requirements
- **Paper** 1.21.8+
- Java 21+
